title: Uterus anatomy: endometrium, myometrium and cavity
description: The womb in cross-section: endometrium, junctional zone, myometrium, cavity, isthmus and the key clinical boundaries.

questions.question: What are the layers of the uterine wall?
questions.answer: The uterus has an inner endometrium, muscular myometrium and outer serosal or connective covering depending on the region.

questions.question: What happens to the endometrium during the menstrual cycle?
questions.answer: The endometrium responds to changing ovarian hormones. Its functional layer grows and changes during the cycle and is shed if pregnancy does not occur.

questions.question: What is the fundus?
questions.answer: Dome above the two tubal openings. Function: Expands in pregnancy; fundal position is an obstetric landmark.

questions.question: Where are the uterine cornua located?
questions.answer: Upper lateral junctions where uterine tubes enter. Function: Communicate with intramural tube segments.

questions.question: What is the function of the endometrium — functionalis?
questions.answer: Function: Proliferates under estrogen and becomes secretory under progesterone. Superficial cyclic glandular layer; sheds with menses.
